Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. My son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of a class, nobody called me, and I want to know who decided that and when.
I'm waiting, Hale. Who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before they did?
I'm sorry? I have a client call in under twenty minutes, Hale. Owen.
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, Owen.
